fib: ______ is the area of mismatch between volumes of material that have a common orientation of the crystallographic axes.
A grain boundary is the area of mismatch between volumes of material that have a common orientation of the crystallographic axes.
______ is defined as the spontaneous magnetic moment per unit volume.
The saturation magnetization Ms is defined as the spontaneous magnetic moment per unit volume.
______ is a lattice distortion created about a line formed by the solidification process, plastic deformation, vacancy condensation or atomic mismatch in solid solutions.
A line defect is a lattice distortion created about a line formed by the solidification process, plastic deformation, vacancy condensation or atomic mismatch in solid solutions.
______ is a planar imperfection, with electron, phonon, and magnon surface states.
The crystal surface is a planar imperfection, with electron, phonon, and magnon surface states.
______ is a lattice irregularity having one or more of its dimensions on the order of an atomic dimension.
A crystalline defect is a lattice irregularity having one or more of its dimensions on the order of an atomic dimension.
